examples.title: Open the Relay Map pew-pew dashboard
examples.input_or_trigger: /agent-relay:relay-map Open the Relay Map dashboard to inspect live agents and message traffic.
prerequisites: Enable the Agent Relay plugin and its bundled relay MCP server.
examples.expected_behavior: Launch the interactive Relay Map MCP App showing live agents, message arcs, health alerts, and token burn.

examples.title: Open Relay Map from MCP
examples.input_or_trigger: Show the Relay Map dashboard filtered to waiting agents.
examples.expected_behavior: Return the fleet summary and render ui://agent-relay/relay-map.html.

antigravity.notes: Install with agy plugin install https://github.com/swack-tools/agent-relay-ai-plugin and open Agent Relay from the Plugins sidebar.

claude-code.notes: Install from swack-tools/agent-relay-ai-plugin and invoke /agent-relay:relay-map or /agent-relay:message-session.

codex.notes: Install from swack-tools/agent-relay-ai-plugin and invoke $relay-map or $message-session.

relay.description: Local stdio MCP server providing 7 agent-relay tools and the interactive Relay Map pew-pew dashboard.
